MIND. [1] [Cann. s.]
Seems to be in a dream, as if things were not real ; feels as if she did not know where she was ; objects seem strange ; feels at times as if she was somebody else ; memory bad ; forgets when speaking what she is going to say, or what she is going to do, unless she makes a note of it, ; cannot follow what persons say to her ; when writing repeats or omits words. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
Makes mistakes in writing.
Says one thing for another when speaking.
Time seems prolonged. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
Voices, including her own, seem to come from a distance ; her own voice seems strange, as if it was somebody else speaking. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
Thoughts seem to stand still.
Feeling as if she would lose her senses. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
Sadness and melancholy.
Despondent in forenoon, lively in afternoon.
Anxious and apprehensive feeling at pit of stomach, with oppression of breath and palpitation ; rising of something warm into throat, with arrest of breathing ; soon something became lodged in trachea, with flushes of heat.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Cann. s.]
Giddiness, when walking, with fear of falling. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
Head feels as if it would fall in all directions. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cann. s.]
Pain in right temple and vertex, as if opening and shutting ; begins on waking, lasts all day ; < from noise. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cann. s.]
After looking long, mistiness before eyes. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
Opacity of cornea after a bee-sting.
Maculæ and ulcers on cornea.
Scrofulous eye troubles.
Cataract.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cann. s.]
Nasty taste in mouth, on waking, returns after meals. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cann. s.]
Does not like meat, of which she used to be fond. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Cann. s.]
Ascites after abuse of quinine.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cann. s.]
Constipation. θ Urinary troubles. θ Phimosis.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cann. s.]
Penis swollen ; thick purulent discharge ; difficulty in making water, not from burning, but from stoppage at intervals, as if from spasm ; child, æt. 6. θ Urethritis.
Pain extending from orifice of urethra backward, burning-biting, posteriorly more sticking, while urinating.
Tearing as if in fibres of urethra, in form of zigzag.
Urging to urinate, with pressive pain.
Pain in neck of bladder and both kidneys ; urging to urinate every fifteen or twenty minutes ; urine yellowish-white and the last mixed with blood, scalding when passed, but < after ; at close of urination very painful spasmodic closing of sphincter and, at same time, very severe stricture and drawing up of anus ; constant urging to stool, with inability.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Cann. s.]
Priapism, with free mucoid discharge. θ Gonorrhœa.
Phimosis, accompanied by constipation.
Inflammatory stage of gonorrhœa. See 21.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Cann. s.]
Infantile leucorrhoea.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Cann. s.]
Post-partum hemorrhage.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cann. s.]
Dyspnœa and extreme agitation ; must sit most of the time. θ Humid asthma.
Wheezing and mucous rales. θ Bronchitis.
Has to stand by open window, leaning forward. θ Asthma.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cann. s.]
Cough, with blood-spitting and stitches in right side. θ Pleurisy.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cann. s.]
A digging beneath upper part of sternum, without oppression of breath.
Stitches in right side. θ Pleurisy.
Spasmodic affections of chest and abdomen, accompanied by urinary troubles.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cann. s.]
Visible palpitation. θ Pneumonia of horses.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Cann. s.]
Pressure as if with a sharp point in coccyx.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Cann. s.]
Contraction of fingers after a sprain.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Cann. s.]
Violent pain with contraction in tendo-achillis and left foot.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cann. s.]
Faint feeling, sometimes faints right off. θ Post-partum hemorrhage.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Cann. s.]
Feels as if hot water was poured over him.
Sensation as if drops of cold water were falling : on head ; from anus ; from heart.
Unendurable fine stitching over whole body, like from a thousand needle-points, at night, when sweating from warm covering, > when uncovering.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Cann. s.]
Child, æt. 6. θ Urethritis.
